title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: A classic cyberpunk novel following a washed-up computer hacker hired for one last job.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A lone astronaut must save Earth from an extinction-level event by solving complex scientific puzzles.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide on how to build good habits and break bad ones using small daily changes.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A psychological thriller about a woman's act of violence against her husband and her therapist trying to uncover her motive.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, the story follows Paul Atreides as he navigates political intrigue, ecological challenges, and prophetic destiny while his family battles rival factions for control of the planet's valuable spice. Themes of power, survival, and the interplay between environment and culture drive the narrative toward a climactic transformation of both protagonist and society.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
description: The novel chronicles the multi-generational saga of the Buendía family in the fictional town of Macondo, weaving history, myth, and the passage of time into a tapestry of love, solitude, and inevitable decline. Themes of cyclical history, the interplay of fate and free will, and the isolation of human experience are explored through surreal events and lyrical prose.

title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl
description: In this powerful memoir, Viktor Frankl recounts his harrowing experiences in Nazi concentration camps, illustrating how the human spirit can endure extreme suffering through the pursuit of purpose. The book blends personal narrative with existential analysis, arguing that meaning can be found even in the bleakest circumstances, and it has become a foundational text in logotherapy and modern psychology.
